description: Rounded Apollo 11 nominal ascent profile reused as a prototype estimate for Apollo 9-11; not a solved flight trajectory.

events.title: Terminal countdown
events.speaker: Launch Director
events.text: Terminal sequence at T-minus 60 seconds. The authorised configuration and readiness file are on the console.

events.title: Ten seconds
events.speaker: Launch Director
events.text: T-minus ten seconds. Terminal sequence continues.

events.title: Tower clear
events.speaker: Flight Director
events.text: Tower clear. Flight Control continues the ascent watch.

events.title: Roll and pitch programme
events.speaker: Guidance Controller
events.text: Roll and pitch programme in progress. Following the planned ascent profile.

events.title: Maximum dynamic pressure region
events.speaker: Flight Director
events.text: Passing the estimated peak loading region. Continuing the ascent watch.

events.title: S-IC cutoff and separation
events.speaker: Propulsion Controller
events.text: S-IC cutoff. Stage separation. S-II sequence underway.

events.title: S-II cutoff and separation
events.speaker: Propulsion Controller
events.text: Second-stage cutoff. Separation. S-IVB sequence follows.

events.title: S-IVB cutoff
events.speaker: Propulsion Controller
events.text: S-IVB cutoff. Preparing the orbit-insertion check.

events.title: Parking orbit insertion
events.speaker: Flight Director
events.text: Parking orbit insertion recorded. Begin spacecraft checkout. We have a mission to fly.
